parameters.name: num_protein_options
parameters.description: Number of protein options in the finite set of proteins

parameters.name: num_vegetable_options
parameters.description: Number of vegetable options in the finite set of vegetables

parameters.name: protein_price_per_100g
parameters.description: Unit price coefficient for each protein option, measured per 100 grams

parameters.name: vegetable_price_per_100g
parameters.description: Unit price coefficient for each vegetable option, measured per 100 grams

parameters.name: vegetable_fiber_per_100g
parameters.description: Fiber coefficient for each vegetable option, measured per 100 grams

parameters.name: total_meal_mass_grams
parameters.description: Required total meal mass in grams

parameters.name: min_selected_vegetable_types
parameters.description: Minimum number of distinct selected vegetable options

variables.name: purchased_protein_quantity_grams
variables.description: Purchased quantity for each protein option, in grams

variables.name: purchased_vegetable_quantity_grams
variables.description: Purchased quantity for each vegetable option, in grams

variables.name: protein_selected
variables.description: Binary selection variable indicating whether each protein option is selected

variables.name: vegetable_selected
variables.description: Binary selection variable indicating whether each vegetable option is selected

constraints.name: nonnegative_purchase_quantities
constraints.description: Purchased protein and vegetable quantities must be nonnegative

constraints.name: binary_selection_variables
constraints.description: Protein and vegetable selection variables must be binary

constraints.name: total_mass_requirement
constraints.description: The total purchased mass across all selected proteins and vegetables must equal the required meal mass

constraints.name: budget_limit
constraints.description: The total purchase cost computed from purchased quantities and per-100-gram prices must not exceed the budget

constraints.name: single_protein_selection
constraints.description: Exactly one protein option must be selected

constraints.name: minimum_vegetable_selection
constraints.description: At least K distinct vegetable options must be selected

constraints.name: selection_quantity_link_protein
constraints.description: If a protein is not selected, its purchased quantity must be zero; purchased protein quantity is allowed only when selected

constraints.name: selection_quantity_link_vegetable
constraints.description: If a vegetable is not selected, its purchased quantity must be zero; purchased vegetable quantity is allowed only when selected

objectives.name: fiber_maximization
objectives.description: maximize total fiber intake from the selected and purchased vegetable quantities

final_objective.description: maximize total fiber intake from vegetables; single linear objective
